title: Learning Domain Trajectories with Flow Matching for Gradual Domain Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30685v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large distribution shifts remain a primary obstacle for domain generalization and unsupervised adaptation. Although gradual domain adaptation alleviates this difficulty by introducing ordered intermediate domains, most existing approaches still operate in a discrete, step-wise manner, which can accumulate errors and often relies on unstable Min--Max optimization. We propose \textbf{FlowGDA}, a flow-matching framework that models gradual adaptation as \emph{continuous} transport on a statistical manifold in a representation space. FlowGDA learns time-dependent velocity fields that induce smooth domain trajectories, using a simulation-free regression objective rather than adversarial training. To prevent semantic drift, we couple left-to-right transport between consecutive domains with a source-anchored transport and a semantic consistency loss, and we further stabilize learning via a two-stage sequential optimization scheme. translated_title: 基于流匹配的渐进域自适应域轨迹学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.30685v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大幅度的分布偏移仍然是领域泛化和无监督自适应面临的主要障碍。尽管渐进域自适应通过引入有序的中间域缓解了这一难题，但大多数现有方法仍以离散、逐步的方式进行，这会累积误差，并且往往依赖于不稳定的 Min-Max 优化。我们提出 FlowGDA，一个流匹配框架，它将渐进自适应建模为表示空间中统计流形上的连续输运。FlowGDA 通过学习随时间变化的速度场来诱导平滑的域轨迹，并采用无需模拟的回归目标，而非对抗训练。为防止语义漂移，我们将相邻域之间的从左到右输运与源域锚定的输运以及语义一致性损失相耦合，并通过两阶段顺序优化方案进一步稳定学习过程。大量实验……
tldr: 提出FlowGDA框架，利用流匹配将渐进域自适应建模为表示空间统计流形上的连续输运，通过学习时间依赖的速度场生成平滑域轨迹，避免了传统离散逐步方法中的误差累积和不稳定的对抗训练。
en_tdlr: FlowGDA, a flow-matching framework that models gradual domain adaptation as continuous transport on a statistical manifold, learning smooth domain trajectories that avoid error accumulation and unstable adversarial training of discrete step-wise approaches.
